title: P10 — 그네 타는 법에 특허가 났다 (스티븐 올슨 / US6368227B1)

beats.ko: 그네 타는 법, 특허가 될 수 있을까요?
beats.en: Can a way of swinging on a swing be patented?

beats.ko: 이천 년 겨울, 특허청에 서류 한 장이 들어옵니다.
beats.en: In the winter of 2000, one filing reached the office.
The title was simply "Method of Swinging on a Swing."
Not the back-and-forth kind you know.
You pull alternately on one chain, then the other.
The swing then moves side to side.
That's all of it. Four claims, nothing more.
The patent office let it through.

beats.ko: 본문 끝엔 이렇게 적혀 있었죠. '사용권 문의 환영.'
beats.en: The last line reads: licenses available upon request.

beats.ko: 그런데 등록 여섯 주 만에 재심사가 걸립니다.
beats.en: Six weeks after it issued, reexamination began.
Older swing patents surfaced, one after another.
The result was one line: all claims cancelled.
The attorney who wrote that filing was his father.
And the son named as inventor was seven years old.
